evidence: bare_number_card: seg2:start to seg2:end are two identical yellow circles that both say 8.3. They are just numbers on blobs and show no comparison at all.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: Both circles are labelled 'Before 2016 (1988-2013)' and both read 8.3. The narration contrasts 8 seconds a year before super shoes with almost 30 seconds a year after, but the 'since 2016 ~30' value never appears. The kicker says 'BEFORE 2016 (1988-2013) TOPS THE LIST', which is the opposite of the claim.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison machine was bound to the same data row twice, so the after-2016 series is missing. The kicker was generated from that wrong ranking.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Bind the two sides to before-2016 (8.3 s/yr) and since-2016 (~30 s/yr) with distinct labels and units ('sec/yr'). Draw the gap as the subject's own physics: two runners or shoe-prints covering ground per year, the post-2016 one pulling ~3.6x further. Data should be the one driving the faster runner. Remove the inverted kicker.
